annotations.title: Has this product or company been recalled?

description: Search U.S. recalls by product words and/or company: FDA food, drug and medical-device recalls (enforcement reports) and CPSC consumer-product recalls and NHTSA vehicle, equipment, tire and child-seat recalls. Returns matching recalls newest first with class, reason, status and dates, the total number on record, and the firms with the most matches. Pass recall_id to get one recall.

class_i.description: Only Class I (the most serious FDA class).

query.description: Product words, e.g. "peanut butter", "infusion pump", "baby crib".

recall_id.description: One recall by its number (e.g. F-0123-2025, Z-0456-2024, D-0789-2023, or a CPSC number).

since.description: Only recalls initiated on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

type.description: food, drug, device (FDA), product (CPSC) or vehicle (NHTSA). Default all.

until.description: Only recalls initiated on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: search_recalls
title: Has this product or company been recalled?
